Matt placed a fresh character sheet in front of her.

“Every good campaign needs someone who knows what the party can actually afford.”

Vesper picked up the pencil.

“What is my starting equipment?”

A brass calculator appeared.

Then a ledger.

Then a set of enchanted glasses that revealed hidden fees, predatory contracts and subscriptions nobody remembered authorizing.

The System chimed.

FINANCIAL SIGHT UNLOCKED.

Vesper looked across the table.

Tiny red numbers hovered above every unnecessary expenditure.

She slowly turned toward CJ.

He covered his emergency teleportation-rock subscription with both hands.

“These are essential.”

“You have fourteen.”

“They have different destinations.”

“You labeled six of them ‘bathroom.’”

“Bathrooms are important.”

Vesper opened the ledger.

For the first time, the Multi-Multiverse’s wealth stopped being a dragon’s hoard and became a system people could understand.

Resources entered.

Resources left.

Labor was recorded.

Needs were separated from emergencies.

Emergencies were separated from CJ throwing quartz at the floor to see what happened.

Then another notification appeared.

ADMISSION CONFIRMED.

PROGRAM: MULTIVERSAL ACCOUNTING AND PRACTICAL MAGIC

LOCATION: MAGIC COLLEGE

Vesper froze.

Her six eyes read the message independently.

All six reached the same conclusion.

“I’m going to Magic College.”

CJ stood so quickly his chair fell backward.

Rey screamed from the Goon Couch.

Ren slapped both hands on the table.

Matt lifted the miniature administration bathroom like a ceremonial trophy.

Vesper stared at the acceptance notice.

She had been imaginary.

Then alive.

Then loved.

Now she had a job, a ledger and a place waiting to teach her how not to lose either.

CJ held out his hand.

“Professor Vesper?”

She took it.

“Student Vesper,” she corrected.

Then she smiled.

“And Accountant Vesper when the invoice is due.”

The College bell rang.

Somewhere, across the Multi-Multiverse, every unpaid worker looked up.

The books had opened.

Someone was finally keeping track.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
